packageRules.description: Group all non-major updates together and auto-merge

Keep gradle-wrapper on its own branch. Updating it makes Renovate run ./gradlew in its container, which fails here, and while it shared a branch with everything else that one failure blocked the entire non-major batch.

Anything that RUNS the build gets its own branch and a human. Anything the build merely compiles against can batch and auto-merge. Every stuck batch here has been the same shape: a build-system component bundled with libraries, where one incompatible member blocks all the rest. gradle-wrapper did it by erroring inside Renovate's container, which killed the grouped batch for nine months. com.gradleup.shadow 9.6.1 then did it by needing a newer Gradle than the wrapper provides, failing with AdhocComponentWithVariants.addVariantsFromConfiguration. Matched on depType rather than by name. Renovate's Gradle manager assigns depType 'plugin' to anything in a plugins block, which is documented, whereas two earlier attempts to name the plugin failed: matchPackageNames misses because a plugin's packageName is the marker artifact com.gradleup.shadow:com.gradleup.shadow.gradle.plugin, and matchDepNames with the plugin id also matched nothing across a full branch wipe and rescan. Matching the type is also the more durable rule: a plugin added later is covered without anyone remembering to list it.
